title: Natural-number powers of an endofunctor
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a category [def-nagata-category] and let $T:\mathcal C\to\mathcal C$ be an endofunctor (a map on objects and morphisms preserving identities and composition). Its natural-number powers are the endofunctors $T^n$, defined recursively by $T^0=\mathrm{id}_{\mathcal C}$ and $T^{n+1}=T\circ T^n$ for every $n\in\mathbb N$. Thus $T^n(x)$ and $T^n(f)$ are the $n$-fold iterates on objects and morphisms, including the identity at $n=0$.
